description: Search the RBI NBFC register by name/CIN substring, classification or regulation layer. Returns official register rows. Supply q or a filter; a filter without q browses that slice. Registration does not establish creditworthiness.

classification.description: exact RBI classification as it appears in the register, e.g. 'MFI' or 'HFC'

limit.description: maximum rows to return (default 20, capped at 50)

q.description: case-insensitive substring of the registered name or CIN

name: universe_search
title: RBI NBFC register search
